evidence.brief_quote: the combustion chamber was filled with a mixture of nitrogen and a flammable gas (e.g., propane), while an oxygen-nitrogen mixture of up to 85% oxygen flowed from the spherical burner creating an inside-out flame
evidence.brief_reading: That sentence describes the INVERSE flames. In normal flames the roles swap: fuel flows from the burner into an O2/N2 chamber.
evidence.columns: "XO2 before test" and "XO2  after test" are logged per test; the burner carries fuel ("Xf").

material_class: gas flames (spherical porous burner, fuel flowing out), not solid materials
